spec.hypothesis: Within the H100 marketplace-ask series, origins with relative_q80 >= 0.15 are the most volatile stretches, and always-narrow beats medium on that series (0.0560 vs 0.0616). This is a strict subset of the rejected marketplace_ask class, selected by move size instead of unchanged_fraction, so it is not a duplicate. It keeps the neocloud H100_80GB origins (q80 below 0.003) out of the class, which made earlier broader cutoffs not programmable.
